claims.statement: The workflow turns an approved brief into governed multimodal planning and review artifacts.
The synthetic brief can run through planning, offline routing preflight and quality-fixture review without a paid API.
Core, routing, quality and governance paths have deterministic regression tests.
Reviewed alternative routing policies can be compared offline while preserving abstract-unit limits and zero external calls.
Quota or abstract-budget overflow blocks atomically with no prepared envelopes or external call.
Live-routing and token-cost components were screened with exact version and license evidence; neither was forced into the offline default.
A synthetic atomic-quota requirement is linked to its decision, implementation and regression case.
No-model, no-media, no-price and real-pilot boundaries are explicit.
A versioned provider-capability fixture detects removed deliverables, removed aspect ratios and reduced duration before any future request planning.
Blocked quality and provider-capability outcomes are exported as a deterministic human-review queue with no decision execution or platform writes.
Synthetic reviewer records are validated as append-only history without applying decisions or publishing assets.
Accepted synthetic reviewer feedback can be replayed as regression metadata while pending feedback remains excluded and no decision or asset publication occurs.

boundaries: Synthetic brief and quality labels only; no real campaign, media-quality or adoption claim.
Abstract cost units are not currency, tokens, provider pricing or a commercial quote.
A real pilot requires approved provider terms, credentials, budgets, rights review, generated assets and accountable human approval.
